name: Trastuzumab
mechanism: Humanised IgG1 against the HER2 extracellular domain; blocks ligand-independent signalling and kills through ADCC
indications: HER2-positive breast cancer; HER2-positive gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
note: FDA label for Herceptin, first approved 25 September 1998. Open Targets lists the trastuzumab conjugates against ERBB2 but not the parent antibody, so without this row the table shows T-DM1 and T-DXd and no trastuzumab
